messages.subject: Copy feature - scaling parameter
parts:
Dear INLA users,

When we use the copy feature for a model with two likelihoods and we use a scaling parameter, say \beta, what does the posterior mean of \beta mean? Especially if the posterior mean is negative?

Thank you in advance,
Lídia
